name: Qarinah
source: A young Dream Succubus, and the ruler of her kingdom of sleep, though she doesn't seem to take her position very seriously. Largely preoccupied with sex, she nevertheless manages to keep her position on the Council. Luck? Or perhaps something lurks deep within the dreams…
